paragraphs.anchor: And he caused his children to

paragraphs.text: By the charge given to Moses.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Meaning by his prophets, but their hearts were not touched to believe and repent, without which the preaching of the word has no effect.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Thus affliction gives understanding: for he that hated God in his prosperity now in his misery seeks him.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Which Solomon had caused to be made.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Thus by ignorance they were deceived, thinking it nothing to keep the altars, so that they worshipped God: but it is idolatry to worship God any other way than he has appointed.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Which although it is not contained in the Hebrew, yet because it is here mentioned and is written in the Greek, we have placed it in the end of this book.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: Because he had so horribly offended against the Lord, they did not bury him in the sepulchres of the kings, but in the garden of the king's house.
